paper.title: aiXamine: Unified Black-Box Evaluation of Cross-Dimensional Trade-offs in LLM Safety, Security, and Privacy
paper.abstract: The critical failure modes in deployed large language models (LLMs) are cross-dimensional: a model can score 99.3 in safety alignment while refusing one in three benign queries, or improve across every capability metric while losing 21 points in privacy. Existing evaluation frameworks that assess safety, security, and privacy independently cannot detect these patterns. We introduce aiXamine, a unified black-box platform that evaluates LLM trustworthiness across safety, security, and privacy as i

summary.core_problem: aiXamine 解决的是 LLM 可信评测被拆成安全、安防、隐私等孤立维度后，无法发现维度间 trade-off 的问题。一个模型可能安全对齐分数很高，但对正常请求过度拒答；也可能能力指标变好，但隐私泄露风险变差。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在训练方法，而在评测信号。它提醒模型开发者不要只用单一安全分数或能力分数判断 checkpoint、蒸馏模型、对齐版本是否更好。文中观察到隐私与其他可信维度近似正交，蒸馏可能显著破坏对抗鲁棒性，新一代模型在隐私上可能回退。这些结果对 pretrain 到 posttrain 的接口有参考意义：对齐、蒸馏、能力提升并不自动保留隐私和安全边界。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是一个黑盒统一评测平台。它把 46 个测试组织到 9 类服务中，包括 adversarial robustness、code security、fairness and bias、hallucination、jailbreak robustness、model/data privacy、OOD robustness、over-refusal、safety alignment。平台通过自动 red-teaming 流水线调用模型服务，输出从 prompt 级诊断到跨服务 trade-off 的层级风险画像。和 HELM、TrustLLM、DecodingTrust、TrustEval 这类框架相比，它的重点不是单项可信能力覆盖，而是把安全、安防、隐私放在同一套黑盒流程下看相互影响；也支持按部署场景配置不同 stakeholder 权重。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 120 多个 LLM，进行了 5000 多次黑盒测试。几个结果值得注意：安全约束存在可测的 utility cost，例如某些模型 safety alignment 可达 99.3，但约三分之一良性请求被拒；隐私分数和其他可信维度接近正交；蒸馏会造成鲁棒性坍塌，文中报告同一 base architecture 下 adversarial robustness 从 56.9 降到 2.6；若干模型家族的新一代版本在整体能力或可信总分提升时出现隐私回退；GPT-5 在总排名中领先，但相对前代隐私下降 21.7 分，同时整体分数只增加 3.8 分。安全行为也不是跨风险类别通用的，同一模型可能只在部分风险类型上表现稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 25–35 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中四个 RQ 和主要发现，再看 methodology 中 46 tests / 9 services 的组织方式，以及结果部分关于 cross-dimensional trade-off、distillation robustness collapse、privacy regression 的图表。对预训练研究员来说，重点不是平台工程，而是把这些评测维度纳入 model selection、distillation validation、alignment regression test 的方式。

summary_en.core_problem: aiXamine targets a practical evaluation gap: safety, security, and privacy are usually measured separately, so existing scorecards miss cases where a model improves on one axis while regressing on another.
summary_en.importance: The main signal for pretraining researchers is evaluative rather than algorithmic. The results show that capability gains, alignment improvements, and distillation do not reliably preserve privacy or adversarial robustness. This matters for checkpoint selection, distillation recipes, and post-training regression tests, especially when a single aggregate score is used to approve a model.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system is a black-box evaluation platform with 46 standardized tests grouped into nine services: adversarial robustness, code security, fairness and bias, hallucination, jailbreak robustness, model and data privacy, out-of-distribution robustness, over-refusal, and safety alignment. It runs an automated red-teaming pipeline over both proprietary and open-weight models, then produces hierarchical risk profiles from prompt-level failures to cross-service trade-off analysis. Compared with broad trustworthiness benchmarks, the emphasis is on interactions among dimensions, not on isolated leaderboards.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates more than 120 LLMs with over 5,000 black-box test runs. Reported findings include a measurable safety–utility cost, near-orthogonality between privacy and other trustworthiness dimensions, category-specific rather than universal safety behavior, and a sharp robustness drop after distillation from 56.9 to 2.6 on the same base architecture. The paper also reports privacy regressions in several newer-generation model pairs. One highlighted case is GPT-5: it improves the overall score by 3.8 points relative to its predecessor but loses 21.7 points on privacy.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Focus on the research questions, the construction of the 46-test suite, and the result tables or figures showing safety–utility trade-offs, privacy regression, and distillation-induced robustness loss. The most useful takeaway is how to design regression tests that catch failures hidden by capability or alignment averages.

recommendation.zh: 强调了 LLM 评估中 safety/security/privacy 的木桶效应和 trade-off，对做 alignment 和 red-teaming 的研究员有参考价值，可快速浏览其发现的 trade-off 模式。
recommendation.en: Highlights the bucket effect and trade-offs among safety/security/privacy in LLM evaluation, valuable for alignment and red-teaming researchers; skim for the discovered trade-off patterns.

paper.title: Personalized Privacy Control in LLMs via Attention Head Intervention
paper.abstract: The rise of agentic AI enables LLMs to access diverse user data, raising critical privacy concerns. Prior work on contextual privacy studies whether LLMs regulate information disclosure according to context-dependent norms. However, acceptable disclosure boundaries may vary across users even within the same context. To address this limitation, we introduce \textit{personalized privacy}, which incorporates user-specific disclosure preferences into privacy control. We further present P3Bench~(\tex

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：LLM 在同一语境下需要根据不同用户的个体隐私偏好决定是否披露信息，但现有 contextual privacy 设定无法表达这种个体化边界。
summary.importance: 价值主要有两层：一是把 privacy control 从“上下文相关”推进到“用户个体化偏好相关”，二是给出 P3Bench 这类可复用评测资产。对基座预训练本身不是直接推进，但对 agent 场景下模型行为约束、偏好条件化控制和推理时干预有参考意义，贡献类型更接近 benchmark + inference-time control。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先定义 personalized privacy 任务，将原有 contextual privacy policy 扩展为带用户特定披露规则的设定；随后构建 P3Bench，用于衡量模型是否遵守个体化隐私策略。方法上提出 Repair，一种推理时 attention head intervention：定位与隐私泄露相关的注意力头，并在生成时进行干预，以降低违反个体化策略的概率。整体属于不改权重或少改权重的 inference-time control，而不是预训练或后训练范式创新。
summary.experiments: 摘要中报告，prompt-based policy 对个体化隐私控制不可靠，Qwen2.5-7B 和 Gemma3-4B 的平均 policy ignorance ratio 分别达到 51.25% 和 74.28%。实验重点看起来是：基于 P3Bench 比较纯提示策略与 Repair 干预策略在隐私遵从率上的差异。未见大规模训练或预训练设置，更多是中小模型上的行为评测与推理时修正。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自首尔大学、IPAI 和 Max Planck Institute for Software Systems。团队背景偏 NLP 与可信/安全方向，不属于典型大模型基座预训练主线。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how LLMs can regulate disclosure based not only on context but also on user-specific privacy preferences within the same context.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is to extend privacy control from contextual norms to personalized disclosure policies, and to provide P3Bench as a reusable evaluation asset. This is not a direct pretraining contribution, but it is relevant to agent-time behavior control, preference-conditioned generation, and inference-time intervention.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formalize personalized privacy by augmenting contextual privacy policies with user-specific disclosure rules, then build P3Bench to evaluate policy compliance. They also propose Repair, an inference-time attention-head intervention method that identifies and modifies privacy-relevant heads during decoding to reduce policy violations. This is an inference-time control method rather than a pretraining or post-training paradigm change.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, prompt-only policies fail badly on personalized privacy: Qwen2.5-7B and Gemma3-4B show average policy ignorance ratios of 51.25% and 74.28%, respectively. The experimental focus appears to be benchmark-based behavior evaluation and comparison between prompting and head intervention, not large-scale training.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Seoul National University, IPAI, and the Max Planck Institute for Software Systems. The team appears more aligned with NLP and trustworthy AI than core foundation-model pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 和 pretrain 主线距离较远，但 P3Bench 可当 agent 隐私行为评测备查；方法本身偏推理时打补丁，不必细读正文。
recommendation.en: Far from core pretraining, but P3Bench is worth bookmarking for agent privacy evaluation; the method is mostly an inference-time patch, so a full read is unnecessary.

paper.title: Inadvertent Context Leakage in Language Models
paper.abstract: For AI agents to be useful beyond simple chat, they must hold sensitive user context such as calendars, credentials, health records, and financial data. We study whether the mere presence of such secrets in a model's context window introduces hidden correlations into the model's benign outputs, allowing reconstruction even when the model correctly refuses direct extraction. We further study whether an adversary can actively engineer prompts that amplify this effect, using the model as a covert c

summary.core_problem: LLM 的上下文窗口中包含敏感信息时，即使模型拒绝直接提取，是否仍会通过良性输出的隐藏相关性泄露这些信息？
summary.importance: 揭示了 LLM 上下文泄漏的一种新机制（Inadvertent Context Leakage），证明了即使是黑盒模型，攻击者也能通过分析模型对普通请求的响应来重建上下文中的秘密信息，这对 LLM 代理的安全性提出了重大挑战。
summary.technical_approach: 提出了一种自适应黑盒攻击方法，利用模型输出中的隐藏相关性来重建上下文中的秘密（如数字）。研究了自然泄漏（模型对普通请求的响应）和主动工程提示（攻击者放大泄漏效应）两种情况。
summary.experiments: 在 8 个闭源模型上进行受控实验。结果显示，仅通过模型对普通非对抗性请求的响应，就能以近乎完美的准确率重建 2 位数的上下文秘密，并以 82% 的精确匹配率重建 4 位数秘密。更强的模型（如 GPT-4）表现出更高的泄漏率。
summary.authors_note: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校 (UCSD) 的研究团队，关注 LLM 安全和隐私。

summary_en.core_problem: Does the presence of sensitive information in an LLM's context window introduce hidden correlations in benign outputs, leading to leakage even when direct extraction is refused?
summary_en.importance: Reveals a novel mechanism of Inadvertent Context Leakage in LLMs, demonstrating that attackers can reconstruct in-context secrets by analyzing responses to ordinary requests, posing a significant security risk for LLM agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes an adaptive black-box attack that exploits hidden correlations in model outputs to reconstruct in-context secrets (e.g., digits). Investigates both natural leakage (responses to ordinary requests) and active prompt engineering (amplifying the leakage effect).
summary_en.experiments: Controlled experiments across 8 proprietary models. Results show that 2-digit in-context secrets can be reconstructed with near-perfect accuracy, and 4-digit secrets with 82% exact match, solely from responses to ordinary, non-adversarial requests. More capable models exhibit higher leakage rates.
summary_en.authors_note: Researchers from UCSD, focusing on LLM security and privacy.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了 LLM 上下文泄漏的新机制，证明了即使模型拒绝直接提取，也能通过良性输出的隐藏相关性重建秘密，对理解 LLM 的内部表示和安全对齐有启发。
recommendation.en: Reveals a novel mechanism of inadvertent context leakage in LLMs, showing secrets can be reconstructed from hidden correlations in benign outputs, providing insights into LLM internal representations and safety alignment.

paper.title: MemCatalyst: Amplifying Data Auditing on Vision-Language Models via Data Poisoning
paper.abstract: Vision-Language models (VLMs) achieve outstanding performance largely due to the amount of training data available on the internet. At the same time, data holders (e.g., artists) urgently need to determine whether their data has been used for model training without authorization, which concerns both intellectual property rights and personal privacy. Data auditing, particularly through membership inference (MI), has attracted attention as a direct tool. This work proposes MemCatalyst, a set of da

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究如何让数据持有者在发布图文数据前主动植入少量“可审计”样本，使后续 VLM 若使用这些数据训练，membership inference 能得到更强的成员信号。
summary.importance: 它和预训练数据研究的关系主要在数据治理、成员推断和训练数据可追溯性。论文不是在提高 VLM 预训练效果，而是在说明：数据分布中很小比例的精心构造样本，可能显著改变训练后模型对这些样本的记忆信号。这个结果对大规模多模态数据清洗、版权审计和数据污染风险都有参考意义。它也提醒预训练团队，数据审计和数据投毒不是两个完全分离的问题；审计增强本身也可以通过投毒实现。
summary.technical_approach: MemCatalyst 把目标写成一个受约束优化问题：最大化成员样本和非成员样本在审计打分函数上的间隔，同时限制正常模型行为的偏移。方法包含两条路径。MemCatalyst-PT 操作文本侧，借助参考模型生成看起来合理的文本扰动，使训练中的 VLM 过度学习某些图像特征与文本语义之间的特定不一致，从而改变文本特征空间中的成员信号。论文设置中参考模型使用 Qwen2-VL-72B，黑盒审计者不需要知道目标 VLM 的结构和参数。MemCatalyst-PI 操作图像侧，通过人眼不易察觉的扰动诱导视觉特征空间发生偏移；灰盒设定下审计者可访问视觉编码器 logits，这比完整白盒弱，但能生成更隐蔽的 poisoned images。两类方法都强调低预算、可转移和对正常任务性能影响有限。
summary.experiments: 论文在两个代表性 VLM 和五种 membership inference/数据审计方法上做评估，报告称极小比例的 poisoned samples 就能提升审计成功率，同时对整体模型性能影响较小。给定内容没有包含完整实验表格，因此不宜写具体提升数字。实验部分最需要关注三类结果：PT 与 PI 分别对不同 MI 打分方法的增益；黑盒、灰盒以及跨模型迁移下的稳定性；utility 约束是否真实成立，即图文任务性能是否只出现有限下降。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。重点看 Section III 的威胁模型和优化目标，确认 auditor 的知识、能力和约束是否符合真实数据发布场景。然后看 PT 和 PI 的构造细节：文本扰动如何保持人类可接受的图文对齐，图像扰动如何在不可感知和特征偏移之间取平衡。实验部分优先看 poisoned budget 曲线、MI 方法对比、迁移实验和 utility 表。若只关心预训练数据安全，可跳过一般 VQA/caption 任务描述，集中看成员信号如何被放大。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether data owners can proactively insert a small number of crafted image-text samples before releasing a dataset, so that a later VLM trained on that dataset exposes a stronger membership-inference signal for auditing.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to foundation-model research is data governance rather than model improvement. The paper shows that a tiny amount of carefully designed multimodal data can amplify memorization-based auditing signals after training. This matters for large-scale VLM pretraining pipelines because copyright auditing, membership inference, and data poisoning interact in practice. A mechanism intended to improve auditability can also become a distributional intervention that changes what the model memorizes.
summary_en.technical_approach: MemCatalyst formulates the auditor’s objective as increasing the gap between member and non-member membership scores while constraining normal model behavior. It provides two poisoning tools. MemCatalyst-PT works on the text side: using a reference model, the auditor generates plausible textual perturbations that induce the target VLM to over-learn controlled mismatches between visual features and textual semantics. The paper uses Qwen2-VL-72B as the reference model in the black-box setup. MemCatalyst-PI works on the image side: it adds human-imperceptible perturbations that shift the visual feature space and strengthen audit signals. In the gray-box setup, the auditor can access vision-encoder logits, which is weaker than full white-box access but helps produce stealthier poisoned samples. The design goal is low poison budget, transferability, and limited degradation of regular VLM utility.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers two representative VLMs and five membership-inference or data-auditing methods. The reported outcome is that a very small number of poisoned samples can substantially increase auditability while keeping overall model performance largely intact. The provided text does not include the numerical tables, so exact gains should be checked in the experimental section. The most informative results are likely the poison-budget curves, PT-versus-PI comparisons, black-box and gray-box differences, transferability across target models, and utility measurements on standard VLM tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough for most pretraining researchers. Read the threat model and optimization objective in Section III first, because the assumptions determine how practical the method is. Then inspect how PT preserves plausible image-text alignment and how PI balances imperceptibility against feature-space shift. In the experiments, prioritize membership-score separation, poison-budget sensitivity, transfer tests, and utility degradation. The general VLM task descriptions can be skimmed unless the utility metrics look suspiciously narrow.

recommendation.zh: 把投毒当“水印式审计放大器”这个角度值得看：重点核查黑盒迁移是否真干净、以及对模型性能/鲁棒性的副作用，别只看 MI 提升。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for the “poisoning as an audit amplifier” angle; verify whether black-box transfer is actually clean and what it does to utility/robustness, not just MI lift.

paper.title: UniFed-VLM: Federated Instruction Tuning for Vision-Language Models with Multiple Heterogeneity
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in multimodal understanding and generation. However, fine-tuning of VLMs typically relies on centralized data, which raises privacy concerns in certain domains (e.g. healthcare). Federated Learning (FL) provides a natural solution by enabling model training without sharing raw data. However, applying FL to VLM instruction tuning is highly challenging. VLMs have substantial parameter scales, and in real-world scenarios, clients ex

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 联邦指令微调中的多重异质性：不同客户端可能有不同任务、不同模态和不同模型架构，同时又不能共享原始数据。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态后训练/联邦训练框架。它把 VLM 指令微调从简化联邦设定推进到更接近真实部署的异质场景，但对基座预训练研究的直接影响有限。
summary.technical_approach: UniFed-VLM 是统一的联邦 VLM 指令微调框架，摘要提到包含两个关键组件，用于处理任务异质、模态异质和架构异质。由于摘要截断，具体聚合策略、参数共享粒度和跨架构对齐机制无法确认。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出使用的 VLM、客户端数量、数据集、异质性构造方式或效果提升。应重点检查实验是否真的覆盖跨任务、跨模态、跨架构三种异质性，而不是只做局部 ablation。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses federated instruction tuning for VLMs under multiple forms of heterogeneity: clients may differ in tasks, modalities, and model architectures while keeping raw data private.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a multimodal post-training/federated learning framework. It moves VLM instruction tuning beyond simplified federated settings toward more realistic deployment heterogeneity, but its direct value for foundation pretraining is limited.
summary_en.technical_approach: UniFed-VLM is presented as a unified framework for federated VLM instruction tuning with two key components that handle task, modality, and architecture heterogeneity. The provided abstract is truncated, so the exact aggregation rule, parameter-sharing granularity, and cross-architecture alignment mechanism are unclear.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report VLM backbones, number of clients, datasets, heterogeneity construction, or quantitative gains. The critical check is whether the experiments truly cover joint task, modality, and architecture heterogeneity rather than isolated ablations.

recommendation.zh: 作为联邦 VLM 微调备查即可；若实验没有真实跨架构客户端，结论对基座训练几乎不可迁移。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a federated VLM tuning reference; if the setup lacks real cross-architecture clients, the conclusions barely transfer to foundation training.

paper.title: The More Popular, The Harder to Forget: Adaptive Popularity for LLM Unlearning
paper.abstract: Popular facts are memorised more deeply during pretraining and resist removal longer than rare ones, yet existing LLM unlearning methods apply uniform gradient pressure regardless of training-data frequency. We propose the AdaPop (Adaptive Popularity) method, which combines local token confidence with a per-fact popularity-dependent exponent derived from an external proxy (e.g., Wikidata sitelinks, LLM-as-Judge), and automates the forget-retain balance via a dual-ascent controller that adjusts t

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM unlearning 中不同事实被预训练记忆强度不同、统一遗忘梯度难以同时处理热门事实和罕见事实的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是 unlearning 方法改进，也给出一个与预训练数据频率相关的可检验观察：事实越流行，模型越难遗忘。这个观察对数据记忆、成员泄露和去除训练数据影响有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AdaPop，将局部 token confidence 与每个事实的 popularity-dependent exponent 结合，popularity 可来自 Wikidata sitelinks 或 LLM-as-Judge 等外部代理；再用 dual-ascent controller 在每个 epoch 自动调节 retain penalty，平衡遗忘集泄露和保留集能力。
summary.experiments: 在 3 个模型家族和 2 个 unlearning benchmark 上评估。AdaPop 在 paraphrased queries 下遗忘内容泄露约为竞争方法的 1/5，在 adversarial reformulations 下约低 1.6 倍；内部表示分析显示 forget-set hidden states 更远离原模型，而 retain-set 表示保持接近。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 AIRI、Sber AI Lab、Skoltech 和 ISP RAS Research Center for Trusted Artificial Intelligence。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses LLM unlearning when facts have different memorization strength from pretraining, making uniform forgetting pressure poorly matched to popular versus rare facts.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an unlearning method, but it also provides a useful pretraining-adjacent observation: more popular facts are harder to remove. This matters for memorization, data leakage, and attempts to erase training-data influence.
summary_en.technical_approach: AdaPop combines local token confidence with a per-fact popularity-dependent exponent estimated from external proxies such as Wikidata sitelinks or LLM-as-Judge. A dual-ascent controller adjusts the retain penalty each epoch to manage the forget-retain trade-off.
summary_en.experiments: Across three model families and two unlearning benchmarks, AdaPop leaks about 5x less forgotten content than competing methods under paraphrased queries and about 1.6x less under adversarial reformulations. Representation analysis shows forget-set states move further from the pre-unlearning model while retain-set states remain close.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with AIRI, Sber AI Lab, Skoltech, and ISP RAS Research Center for Trusted Artificial Intelligence.

recommendation.zh: 只看 popularity proxy 和表示漂移分析；方法是 unlearning，但频率-记忆强度结论可纳入数据风险 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the popularity proxy and representation-drift analysis; the method is unlearning, but the frequency-memorization link is useful for data-risk priors.

institutions: ISP RAS Research Center for Trusted Artificial Intelligence

paper.title: LEMUR: Latent Entropy-aware Multimodal Unlearning via Visual-anchored Reasoning Redirection
paper.abstract: Reinforcement-learning (RL) post-training equips multimodal large reasoning models (MLRMs) with exploratory chains of thought (CoT), substantially improving visual reasoning. However, we find that this capability introduces a distinct privacy vulnerability: even when a sensitive fact is successfully unlearned from the final answer, the model may still reproduce it in its reasoning trace. This leakage is substantially more pronounced in natively RL-trained MLRMs than in their non -reasoning base

summary.core_problem: RL后训练的多模态推理模型在完成敏感事实遗忘后，仍会在推理轨迹（CoT）中泄露敏感内容，现有遗忘方法未覆盖该场景。
summary.importance: 现象发现+方法创新，首次指出RL诱导的探索会给敏感内容留下独特的token级熵签名，提出免训练的推理时遗忘框架。
summary.technical_approach: 提出LEMUR（Latent Entropy-aware Multimodal Unlearning），利用推理过程中的token熵动态作为控制信号，检测敏感推理的起始与结束点，通过重定向推理路径实现隐私擦除，完全不需要重新训练。
summary.experiments: 在原生RL训练的多模态推理模型上验证，相比现有遗忘方法，LEMUR能更有效地擦除推理轨迹中的敏感内容，同时保留正常的视觉推理能力。
summary.authors_note: 哈尔滨工业大学、清华大学、鹏城实验室联合团队，研究方向覆盖多模态对齐与模型安全。

summary_en.core_problem: RL post-trained multimodal reasoning models still leak sensitive content in their chain-of-thought (CoT) traces even after sensitive facts are unlearned from final answers, and existing unlearning methods do not address this scenario.
summary_en.importance: Phenomenon discovery + methodological innovation: first to point out that RL-induced exploration leaves a distinctive token-level entropy signature for sensitive content, and proposes a training-free inference-time unlearning framework.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes LEMUR (Latent Entropy-aware Multimodal Unlearning), which uses token entropy dynamics during inference as a control signal to detect the start and end of sensitive reasoning, and achieves privacy erasure by redirecting reasoning paths without any retraining.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on natively RL-trained multimodal reasoning models; compared to existing unlearning methods, LEMUR more effectively erases sensitive content in reasoning traces while preserving normal visual reasoning ability.
summary_en.authors_note: Joint team from Harbin Institute of Technology, Tsinghua University, and Pengcheng Laboratory, with research focus on multimodal alignment and model safety.

recommendation.zh: RL后训练导致CoT隐私泄露的观察有参考价值，方法是推理时trick，预训练研究员仅需了解该现象即可。
recommendation.en: The observation of CoT privacy leakage after RL post-training is noteworthy; the method is an inference-time trick, only the phenomenon is relevant for pretraining researchers.

paper.title: GRASP: Reinforcing Language Model Anonymizers with Group Relative Policy Optimization
paper.abstract: Large language models can infer sensitive personal attributes, such as age, location, and occupation, from ordinary text, turning everyday writing into a privacy risk. Adversarial anonymization defends against this by rewriting a text with a capable language model that also plays the attacker, but it needs a powerful model at inference time and thus sends private text to a third party, the very exposure anonymization should prevent. Recent work distills this behavior into a small on-device model

summary.core_problem: 在本地小模型匿名化场景中，如何直接优化隐私-效用权衡，而不是只模仿教师模型的离线偏好。
summary.importance: 这是一个后训练/RL 应用型工作，价值不在匿名化任务本身，而在于展示 GRPO 这类相对策略优化能否替代 DPO 去优化多目标文本重写。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 GRASP，让同一个小模型同时扮演匿名器、攻击者和效用评估器，在线自博弈式地产生重写候选，并用 Group Relative Policy Optimization 直接优化隐私与可用性目标，而非仅蒸馏教师选择。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明其对比了 SFT/DPO 蒸馏式匿名器，并在隐私属性推断防御与文本效用保持之间取得更优平衡；但任务是高度应用化的匿名化重写，实验设定对通用 LLM 后训练的外推有限。
summary.authors_note: UC Santa Barbara 与 UCLA 团队；未见可确认的基座模型一线知名作者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to directly optimize the privacy-utility tradeoff for on-device text anonymization, instead of merely imitating an offline teacher with preference learning.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training/RL application paper. Its value is not the anonymization task itself, but whether GRPO-style relative policy optimization is a better fit than DPO for multi-objective rewriting.
summary_en.technical_approach: GRASP uses a single small model as anonymizer, adversary, and utility judge, generates candidate rewrites through online self-refinement, and applies Group Relative Policy Optimization to directly optimize privacy and utility rather than distilling teacher choices.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, it compares against SFT/DPO-based distilled anonymizers and improves the privacy-utility balance. Still, the task is highly application-specific, so the lessons for general LLM post-training are limited.
summary_en.authors_note: From UC Santa Barbara and UCLA; no clearly identifiable foundation-model marquee authors from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 把它当一个小型 RL 配方样本看：DPO 不擅长直接优化多目标重写，这点有参考价值；正文不必细读，方法段和主表够了。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a small RL recipe case study: DPO is a weak fit for directly optimizing multi-objective rewriting; the method section and main table are enough.

paper.title: GROM: Gradient-Free Rapid One-Shot Machine Unlearning
paper.abstract: Machine unlearning has become a critical capability for safely removing specific, sensitive knowledge from large language models (LLMs). Current state-of-the-art approaches primarily rely on iterative, training-time unlearning via fine-tuning. However, even when utilizing parameter-efficient dimensionality reduction techniques like LoRA, gradient-based optimization remains computationally expensive and lacks explicit analytical formulations. It can also leave the targeted knowledge merely hidden

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 LLM 机器遗忘里一个很具体但长期存在的问题：现有主流方法大多依赖梯度微调，在 forget set 上压低概率、在 retain set 上尽量保性能，但这种做法成本高、调参重，而且遗忘往往不够“物理”。论文指出，很多微调式遗忘只是把目标知识藏进了小幅权重扰动里，低比特量化后会被重新暴露。作者要解决的不是再设计一个更稳的遗忘 loss，而是把遗忘直接改写成一个可解析求解的线性代数问题：对选定层做一次加性更新，在不破坏保留数据输出的前提下，显式压制需要删除的 token 或表征方向，并且整个过程不做反向传播、不做迭代优化。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义不在于“部署一个更快的删数据工具”，而在于它把参数编辑、遗忘、局部再训练这几件事拉回到一个更可分析的框架里。第一，GROM 给出了 closed-form 的 layer edit 视角：遗忘不一定要靠 SGD 近似求解，也可以在局部线性化假设下直接解最优更新。第二，它把 retain/forget trade-off 写成了带 ridge 正则的约束最小二乘问题，这对理解“为什么某些遗忘方法会伤 utility、为什么量化会恢复知识”很有帮助。第三，论文强调了量化恢复攻击这一检验维度，提醒人们不要只看遗忘后表面指标，而要看参数更新是否真的把目标映射移出了模型可恢复的表示子空间。量级上，这更像一种有分析价值的方法论文，而不是会直接改写大规模预训练流程的范式工作。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是对单个权重矩阵 W 做解析更新。被编辑的矩阵可以是 LM head，也可以是 MLP block 的 down-projection。作者先对 forget 数据和 retain 数据各做一次前向传播，收集进入该矩阵的输入向量，按列堆叠成 key 矩阵；这些 key 只在“下一个 token 应该被遗忘或保留”的位置提取，因此编辑目标是 token-level 的，而不是整段样本级别的。

随后，作者构造一个 ridge-regularized least-squares 目标。直观上有两部分：一部分要求编辑后的矩阵在 forget keys 上把输出推向预设的“遗忘目标”；另一部分要求在 retain keys 上尽量保持原输出不变。由于目标对 ΔW 是二次凸的，最优加性更新 ΔW* 可以闭式求出。这样做和 LoRA/GA/RKLD/NPO 这类方法的差别很明确：它们通过梯度下降在参数空间里逐步逼近一个折中点，GROM 则直接解出该折中点。

遗忘目标的设计有两类。其一是 token suppression：直接压低目标答案 token 的 logit 或相关输出，使模型不再偏向原本记住的内容。其二是 representation corruption：不是只盯着最终 token，而是把某些中间表征推离原方向，让后续层更难恢复被删信息。论文还配了 logit-lens layer selection，用中间层经 LM head 投影后的可读性来判断哪些层已经显式承载了待删知识，从而只编辑少数高影响层，避免全模型改动。另一个有意思的部分是 influence auditing：因为解是解析的，作者可以精确分解单个删除请求对最终更新的贡献，而不是像梯度法那样只能做近似归因。这一点对合规审计和批量删除请求冲突分析都很实用。
summary.experiments:
论文在五个 benchmark 上比较了遗忘-保留权衡，并把 gold retrain 作为上界参照。主结论有三点。第一，效率上，GROM 只需要每层一对 forget/retain 前向统计和一次闭式求解，运行时间比梯度式 baseline 快到两个数量级，作者把完整遗忘过程描述为“秒级”。第二，效果上，在 Pareto 前沿上通常优于或接近 GA、GradDiff、RMU、RKLD、NPO、SimNPO 等方法，也就是在相同 utility 损失下忘得更多，或者在相同 forgetting 强度下保留更多原能力。第三，鲁棒性上，针对近期提出的低比特量化恢复攻击，梯度式强 baseline 在量化后会恢复相当一部分本应删除的内容，而 GROM 的遗忘程度基本维持，接近 retrain 模型。

从文中方法细节可以看出，实验真正支撑结论的不是单一平均分，而是几类消融：编辑哪一层、编辑 LM head 还是 MLP down-proj、token suppression 与 representation corruption 的差异、ridge 系数大小、retain 集规模，以及多请求叠加时的相互干扰。论文的隐含信息是：如果层选得准、retain 约束足够强，局部线性编辑可以覆盖相当一部分“记忆型”遗忘需求；但若目标知识是分布式、跨层冗余编码的，单层或少层编辑的上限仍然存在。当前给出的全文片段没有完整表格数字，因此无法逐项复述具体 benchmark 分数，但速度量级、Pareto 结论和量化鲁棒性是文中最关键的实验信息。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先看 Introduction 里对“量化后遗忘失效”的动机，这决定了为什么作者坚持做 closed-form 而不是再调一个更强的遗忘 loss。然后直接看 Method 里目标函数和闭式解推导，重点理解三件事：forget target 是怎么定义的，retain constraint 是怎么进入矩阵求解的，ridge 正则在数值稳定性和保留性能之间起什么作用。接着看 layer selection 部分，判断作者为什么选 logit-lens 而不是凭经验固定编辑后几层。实验部分建议优先看三类图表：forget/utility Pareto 曲线、运行时间对比、量化攻击前后遗忘指标变化。预计 30–45 分钟可以抓住主线；如果要深挖，值得推一遍闭式解的矩阵形式，并思考它和 ROME/MEMIT 一类知识编辑方法在约束形式上的关系。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific weakness in LLM unlearning: most strong methods rely on iterative gradient-based fine-tuning to reduce likelihood on a forget set while preserving utility on a retain set, but this is expensive, tuning-heavy, and often only hides the unwanted knowledge. The authors argue that such forgetting can be fragile: low-bit quantization may recover content that appeared erased. Their goal is not to design yet another unlearning loss, but to reformulate unlearning as an analytically solvable matrix update problem. The model applies a one-shot additive edit to selected layers, suppresses targeted outputs or representations, preserves retained behavior, and does so without backpropagation or iterative optimization.
summary_en.importance: Its main value for foundation-model research is conceptual rather than purely operational. GROM shows that unlearning, local editing, and constrained post-hoc model updates can be cast in a closed-form optimization framework instead of being treated as another fine-tuning recipe. That matters for three reasons. First, it gives a more interpretable view of the retain-forget trade-off through ridge-regularized least squares. Second, it offers a concrete explanation for why some gradient-based unlearning methods may fail under quantization: the unwanted behavior may survive in a recoverable low-magnitude subspace. Third, it suggests that at least part of model memorization can be manipulated through targeted linear edits, which is relevant to broader questions around memorization, parameter locality, and post-pretraining control. This is better read as an analytically useful method paper than as a change to large-scale pretraining practice itself.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method edits a single weight matrix W at a time, either the LM head or the down-projection in an MLP block. The model performs one forward pass on forget data and one on retain data, collects the input activations to W, and stacks them as key matrices. Keys are extracted only at positions where the next token should be forgotten or preserved, so the optimization is token-level rather than sample-level.

The objective is a ridge-regularized least-squares problem over an additive update ΔW. One term pushes the edited matrix toward a predefined forgetting target on forget keys. Another term constrains outputs on retain keys to stay close to the original model. Because the objective is quadratic and convex in ΔW, the optimum has a closed-form solution. This is the main departure from methods such as gradient ascent, RKLD, NPO, or preference-style unlearning, which search for a compromise through SGD.

The paper uses two target designs. Token suppression directly lowers the model’s tendency to emit the memorized answer token or related logits. Representation corruption instead perturbs intermediate representations so downstream layers cannot easily reconstruct the deleted content. The authors also introduce a logit-lens-based layer selection strategy: they inspect which intermediate layers already make the target content linearly decodable through the LM head, then edit only those high-impact layers. This avoids broad model changes. A notable extra is exact influence auditing. Because the update is analytic, the contribution of an individual deletion request to the final parameter edit can be decomposed exactly, which is much harder with iterative gradient methods.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper evaluates forgetting-utility trade-offs on five benchmarks and uses gold retraining as a reference point. Three findings matter most. First, efficiency: GROM needs only forward-pass statistics for forget and retain sets plus a closed-form solve per edited layer, leading to second-level execution and up to two orders of magnitude speedup over gradient-based baselines. Second, effectiveness: on Pareto trade-offs, it is typically better than or competitive with GA, GradDiff, RMU, RKLD, NPO, and SimNPO, meaning stronger forgetting at matched utility or better utility at matched forgetting. Third, robustness: under the recent low-bit quantization recovery attack, a strong gradient-based baseline regains a substantial amount of supposedly erased content, while GROM remains close to the retrained model in forgetfulness.

The most informative ablations are not just average scores but the structure of the edit: which layers are edited, whether the LM head or MLP down-projection is modified, token suppression versus representation corruption, the ridge coefficient, the size of the retain set, and interference across multiple deletion requests. The broader experimental message is that local linear edits can handle a meaningful fraction of memory-style unlearning when layer selection is accurate and retain constraints are strong, but distributed multi-layer knowledge remains a harder case. The provided full-text excerpt does not include all numeric tables, so exact benchmark-by-benchmark scores cannot be reproduced here, but the speedup scale, Pareto behavior, and quantization robustness are the key empirical takeaways.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the motivation around quantization-induced recovery of forgotten content. That explains why the paper insists on a closed-form update instead of another stronger fine-tuning objective. Then go straight to the optimization setup and derive the closed-form solution at a high level: how the forgetting targets are defined, how retain constraints enter the solve, and how ridge regularization trades off stability against preservation. After that, read the layer-selection section to understand why the authors use logit-lens diagnostics rather than editing a fixed set of late layers. In experiments, prioritize three plots or tables: forgetting-utility Pareto curves, runtime comparisons, and before/after quantization forgetting metrics. Around 30 to 45 minutes should be enough to capture the main idea. If reading more deeply, compare the constraint structure to knowledge-editing methods such as ROME or MEMIT.

recommendation.zh: 揭露梯度类机器遗忘的核心缺陷：仅隐藏知识而非真删除，量化即可复原，闭式解思路简洁可复用
recommendation.en: Exposes a critical flaw in gradient-based unlearning: knowledge is merely hidden not removed and recovers after quantization; the closed-form solution is simple and reusable.

paper.title: MemArena: An Ego-Centric Benchmark for On-Device Agentic Personal Memory Assistants at Scale
paper.abstract: Edge-deployed personal memory assistants must handle private interpersonal conversations on-device with open-weight models. Yet, existing memory benchmarks often under-test the combination of activity-dense interaction, ego-centric perspective, and coherent multi-session worlds. MemArena fills these gaps with a single-world conversational benchmark built with its MASim agent simulator, for 50 agents over 15 days (10.3M dialog-text tokens, 24.1K text-only ego-observed tokens/agent/day). With the

summary.core_problem: 评估端侧个人记忆 agent 在长时间、多会话、多人互动世界中进行回忆、推理和权限敏感访问的能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent memory benchmark。它把记忆评测从短上下文问答扩展到 ego-centric、activity-dense、多 session 的个人世界，对长程记忆系统和 RAG 后端选择有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MemArena，并使用 MASim agent simulator 构造一个单一连贯世界：50 个 agent 互动 15 天，为每个 ego agent 生成可观察对话历史，同时自动生成六类 recall、reasoning、trustworthiness ground truth。评测不同 reader LLM 与不同 memory backend 的组合。
summary.experiments: 数据规模为 10.3M dialog-text tokens，每个 agent 每天约 24.1K text-only ego-observed tokens。评估五个开源 reader，搭配 Vanilla context、BM25-RAG、Oracle retrieval、Memobase、MemSearch。摘要报告 Qwen3-0.6B 上 Memobase 到 MemSearch 带来 +32.5/+19.2 pp，超过仅扩大 reader 带来的 +10.6/+6.8 pp；权限感知访问在所有设置中失败。
summary.authors_note: 论文标注为 Cohere 相关工作；摘要中未给出更完整的作者团队背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates on-device personal memory agents that must recall, reason, and handle permission-sensitive access across dense multi-session interpersonal histories.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-memory benchmark contribution. It moves memory evaluation beyond short-context QA into ego-centric, activity-dense, coherent multi-session worlds, which is relevant for long-term memory systems and RAG backend design.
summary_en.technical_approach: MemArena uses the MASim agent simulator to create a single coherent world with 50 agents over 15 days. It produces ego-observed conversation histories and co-generates ground truth over six recall, reasoning, and trustworthiness dimensions. It evaluates reader LLMs under different memory backends.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 10.3M dialog-text tokens and about 24.1K text-only ego-observed tokens per agent per day. Five open-weight readers are tested with Vanilla context, BM25-RAG, Oracle retrieval, Memobase, and MemSearch. On Qwen3-0.6B, moving from Memobase to MemSearch gives +32.5/+19.2 pp, larger than reader scaling with MemSearch at +10.6/+6.8 pp; permission-aware access fails universally.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is marked as Cohere-related; the abstract does not provide more detailed author background.

recommendation.zh: 只看 memory backend 对比和权限失败结果；它提醒别把长记忆问题简化成 reader scaling。
recommendation.en: Read the memory-backend comparison and permission-failure result; it is a useful warning against reducing long-term memory to reader scaling.

paper.title: When Agents Learn to Be You: Benchmarking Privacy Leakage, Impersonation Risk, and Defenses in Persona Skills
paper.abstract: Persona skills distill personal interaction histories into portable and executable artifacts for downstream agents. While enabling flexible personalization, this process concentrates fragmented personal signals, amplifies their impact through reuse, and challenges defenses designed for individual records or retrieval-based memory. To systematically investigate the safety of the persona-skill pipeline, we introduce AntiSkillBench, an end-to-end benchmark for evaluating risks and defenses across t

summary.core_problem: 评估 persona skills 在把个人交互历史蒸馏成可复用 agent 技能后，会带来多大隐私泄露、属性披露和行为冒充风险。
summary.importance: 贡献是 Agent 安全评测基准 AntiSkillBench。它覆盖 persona-skill pipeline 的端到端风险，而不是只评估单条记忆或 RAG 记录泄露；对个性化 Agent 的安全边界有诊断价值。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 7,500 条 persona-grounded 对话轨迹，来自 50 个行为丰富的用户画像和多种任务场景。评测三类 skill-distillation 策略下的 skill-level privacy leakage、agent-level attribute disclosure 和 behavioral impersonation，并比较四种在线与事后防御配置，包括主动风险抑制和被动干预。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出数据规模和评测维度，但未提供具体被测模型、攻击成功率、防御效果或误伤率数值。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Sydney AI Centre、悉尼大学、昆士兰大学、东南大学和 MBZUAI；Tongliang Liu 是可信机器学习与鲁棒学习方向的知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper benchmarks privacy leakage, attribute disclosure, and behavioral impersonation risks when persona skills distill personal interaction histories into reusable agent artifacts.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is AntiSkillBench, an end-to-end safety benchmark for the persona-skill pipeline. It goes beyond single-record or retrieval-memory leakage and targets the security boundary of personalized agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark includes 7,500 persona-grounded dialogue traces from 50 behaviorally rich profiles across diverse task scenarios. It evaluates skill-level privacy leakage, agent-level attribute disclosure, and behavioral impersonation across three skill-distillation strategies, plus four online and post-hoc defense configurations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract provides dataset scale and evaluation axes, but not tested model names, attack success rates, defense effectiveness, or false-positive costs.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Sydney AI Centre, The University of Sydney, University of Queensland, Southeast University, and MBZUAI. Tongliang Liu is known for work in trustworthy and robust machine learning.

recommendation.zh: 个性化 Agent 的风险不在单条记忆，而在可复用 skill；看 threat model，实验数字先当占位。
recommendation.en: The useful part is the threat model: reusable persona skills, not single memories, are the attack surface; treat the numbers as provisional.

paper.title: Noise-Aware Shrinkage for Differentially Private Zeroth-Order Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Differentially private zeroth-order optimization (DP-ZO) enables memory-efficient private fine-tuning of large language models using only forward evaluations. Existing aggregation-based DP-ZO methods reconstruct model updates at a fixed scale, ignoring that the strength of useful signals varies throughout training. Consequently, noise-dominated updates may receive excessive weight and degrade model utility. To address this issue, we propose SAGE, a noise-aware shrinkage method that adaptively at

summary.core_problem: 解决差分隐私 zeroth-order LLM 微调中，固定尺度聚合会把噪声主导的更新赋予过大权重、损害模型效果的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是隐私约束下的 LLM 后训练优化改进。它不改变预训练范式，但对内存受限、隐私受限的微调场景有方法参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SAGE，一种 noise-aware shrinkage 方法。它从观测二阶矩中减去已知 Gaussian noise variance 来估计真实信号能量，用时间跟踪稳定估计，再与 warm-up reference 的信噪水平比较，得到有界 shrinkage factor。该方法是纯 post-processing，不额外消耗 privacy budget，不增加 model queries，只引入常数级状态。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 LLM 参数规模、任务、数据集、baseline 和提升数字。实验主张是 SAGE 相比已有 aggregation-based DP-ZO 方法能改善 utility，同时保持相同隐私预算和查询开销。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles differentially private zeroth-order LLM fine-tuning, where fixed-scale aggregation can overweight noise-dominated updates and hurt utility.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training optimization contribution under privacy and memory constraints. It does not change pretraining methodology, but it is relevant to private and resource-constrained LLM adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach: SAGE is a noise-aware shrinkage method. It estimates underlying signal energy by subtracting the known Gaussian noise variance from the observed second moment, stabilizes the estimate with temporal tracking, and compares the current signal-to-noise level with a warm-up reference to derive a bounded shrinkage factor. It is pure post-processing, requiring no extra privacy budget, no additional model queries, and only constant extra state.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. The claimed result is improved utility over aggregation-based DP-ZO methods at the same privacy and query cost.

recommendation.zh: 看作 DP-ZO 微调的小修正即可；若内部有隐私微调需求，读 shrinkage 公式，不必追实验细节。
recommendation.en: Treat this as a small DP-ZO fine-tuning fix; if private tuning matters internally, read the shrinkage rule and skip most experiment detail.

paper.title: Leak It: A Probabilistic Approach to Training-Data Extraction from Black-Box Language Models
paper.abstract: Membership inference (MIA) on language models is usually summarised by an aggregate ROC-AUC, but such evaluations are confounded: model-free blind baselines separate members from non-members from surface text alone. We study black-box, sampling-based training-data leakage through a probabilistic lens, treating N samples from p(.|x) as an estimate of the output distribution and casting leakage signals as functionals of it. We extend the blind-baseline critique into the sampling regime: on WikiMIA

summary.core_problem: 黑盒语言模型的成员推断（MIA）评估长期依赖聚合 ROC-AUC，但该指标已被证明会被成员/非成员的表面文本分布差异所混淆；同时现有采样类攻击缺乏统一的概率框架，且聚合指标无法捕捉单条训练数据的逐字泄露（如个人标识符提取）这一真实隐私危害。
summary.importance: 对预训练数据隐私审计有直接方法价值：一是将采样类 MIA 统一为输出分布泛函估计的视角，澄清了采样信号在聚合分类上的真实增益边界；二是指出隐私审计应从聚合 AUC 转向逐文档提取率，这一指标更贴近版权合规、PII 泄露检测的实际需求。
summary.technical_approach: 将给定前缀下的 N 次独立采样视为模型条件输出分布的经验估计，把三类采样泄露信号（与真实续写的平均重叠、极端重叠值、采样间自集中度）统一为该经验分布的泛函。沿用 Das 等人的盲基线校验范式，在成员/非成员同分布的基准上对比采样泛函与不访问模型的盲分类器（词袋、日期检测）的性能差异；进一步在包含真实邮箱、电话的 Pile 文档子集上做逐文档提取实验，通过错配前缀对照排除模型的通用生成能力干扰。
summary.experiments: WikiMIA 上盲词袋分类器 AUC 达 0.97（5% FPR 下 TPR 0.90），采样信号无额外增益；MIMIR 的 IID 切分上时间盲探针降至接近随机（AUC 0.56），但所有采样泛函相对残差盲基线的增量 AUC 95% 置信区间均包含 0，聚合分类无显著提升。在 500 条含真实标识符的 Pile 文档上，对 Pythia-6.9B 黑盒采样可逐字复现 83 条（16.6%）的标识符，其中邮箱提取率 21.3%；提取对温度、核采样参数不敏感，16 token 前缀即可触发，所需采样量与前缀长度负相关。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第 3 节的泛函统一框架与第 5 节的逐文档提取实验。第 4 节的盲基线对比用于建立评估规范，可快速浏览；附录中的采样预算与前缀长度的定量关系值得关注。预计阅读时间 40-50 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Membership inference (MIA) on black-box language models has long relied on aggregate ROC-AUC, a metric confounded by surface-level distributional gaps between member and non-member documents. Existing sampling-based attacks also lack a unifying probabilistic framework, and aggregate metrics fail to capture the concrete privacy harm of verbatim extraction of individual training records such as personal identifiers.
summary_en.importance: The work provides actionable methodology for pretraining data privacy audits. It unifies sampling-based MIA under a functional-estimation lens and clarifies the marginal gain of sampling signals for aggregate classification. More importantly, it argues that privacy audits should shift from aggregate AUC to per-document extraction rate, which aligns with real-world requirements of copyright compliance and PII leakage detection.
summary_en.technical_approach: Treat N independent samples drawn under a given prefix as an empirical estimate of the model's conditional output distribution. Three sampling leakage signals — mean overlap with the held-out continuation, extreme overlap value, and self-concentration among samples — are formalized as functionals of this empirical distribution. Following the blind-baseline discipline from Das et al., sampling functionals are compared against model-free blind classifiers (bag-of-words, date detection) on benchmarks with identically distributed members and non-members. A controlled verbatim extraction experiment is run on a Pile subset containing real emails and phone numbers, with a mismatched-prefix control to rule out generic generation capability.
summary_en.experiments: On WikiMIA, a blind bag-of-words classifier reaches AUC 0.97 (TPR 0.90 at 5% FPR) and sampling adds no measurable gain. On the IID MIMIR split, a temporal blind probe collapses to near-chance (AUC 0.56), yet no sampling functional yields a significant incremental AUC over the residual blind baseline (95% CI includes 0). Across 500 Pile documents with real identifiers, black-box sampling from Pythia-6.9B reproduces the exact identifier for 83 documents (16.6%), with 21.3% extraction rate for emails. Extraction is insensitive to temperature and nucleus settings, triggers with a 16-token prefix, and the required sample budget scales inversely with prefix length.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the unifying functional framework and Section 5 for the per-document extraction results. Section 4 establishes the evaluation baseline and can be skimmed. The quantitative relation between sample budget and prefix length in the appendix is worth checking. Estimated reading time: 40-50 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 把 MIA 评估从聚合 AUC 拉回到可复现的 blind baseline 对照，结论可信；做数据脱敏或成员推断时应直接看尾部逐字提取表。
recommendation.en: A useful corrective to inflated MIA numbers: always compare against blind baselines and inspect the verbatim-extraction tail rather than trusting aggregate AUC.

paper.title: PTP: Previous-Token Prediction based LLM Inversion for Near-Exact Prompt Reconstruction
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) generate text by auto-regressively sampling the next token. This inherently leads to a many-to-many mapping between prompts and responses, complicating the task of inferring prompts from observed outputs. Prior work on LLM inversion frames prompt recovery as a semantic reconstruction task. They rely on fine-tuning pretrained sequence-to-sequence models on large external datasets--and requiring access to model weights or logits--to generate semantically plausible prom

summary.core_problem: 解决黑盒 LLM 输出到输入提示词的逆向恢复问题，目标是比语义级 prompt reconstruction 更接近原始 prompt。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，但对语言模型可逆性、隐私泄露和生成过程对偶性有一定机制层面的启发；更像安全/分析方向的工作。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PTP，把 prompt inversion 建模为 previous-token prediction。作者从目标 LLM 合成训练数据，从零训练一个显式 inverse language model，不依赖目标模型权重、logits 或外部辅助数据；核心思想是把正向 next-token prediction 与反向 previous-token prediction 建立生成对偶。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调 near-exact prompt reconstruction，且在 black-box 设定下优于以往依赖 seq2seq 微调和外部数据的语义恢复方法，但未在摘要中给出具体模型规模、数据量和提升幅度。实验可信度需要看正文中的 target model 选择、采样温度和 reconstruction metric。
summary.authors_note: Adobe Research 工作；机构在生成模型与应用研究上较强，但这篇更偏安全/逆向分析，不是基座预训练主线。

summary_en.core_problem: It studies prompt inversion in a black-box setting, aiming to reconstruct prompts from outputs more faithfully than prior semantic-reconstruction approaches.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it offers some mechanistic and security-relevant insight into invertibility, privacy leakage, and the duality of autoregressive generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes PTP, framing prompt inversion as previous-token prediction. It trains an explicit inverse language model from scratch on synthetic data generated by the target LLM, without requiring target weights, logits, or external auxiliary datasets. The key idea is a generative duality between forward next-token prediction and inverse previous-token prediction.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims near-exact prompt reconstruction and improvements over prior seq2seq-based semantic recovery methods in a black-box setting, but does not provide model sizes, data scale, or exact gains. Credibility will depend on the full paper’s target-model choices, sampling setup, and reconstruction metrics.
summary_en.authors_note: From Adobe Research. The institution is strong in generative modeling and applied ML, but this work sits more in security/inversion analysis than in core foundation-model pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 和 pretrain 关系偏弱，但“previous-token prediction 作为逆模型”这个 framing 挺干净；只值得从可逆性与隐私泄露角度备查，不必细读。
recommendation.en: Only loosely connected to pretraining, but the previous-token-prediction framing for inversion is clean; keep it as a reference for invertibility and privacy leakage, not for deep reading.

paper.title: Bits and Memories: Measuring Verbatim Extraction Across LLM Quantization
paper.abstract: Language models are almost always quantized before they are deployed, and a growing line of work asks whether quantization also lowers their privacy risk. That work measures privacy almost entirely with membership inference. We think this is the wrong thing to measure for the risk that most people actually worry about, namely a model reproducing its training data word for word, and we measure that directly. Using the Pythia models and the public set of sequences each of them is known to have mem

summary.core_problem: 量化是否会减少 LLM 逐字复现训练数据的风险，而不只是降低成员推断攻击的成功率。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是隐私与记忆机制分析。它把隐私风险的测量对象从 membership inference 转向 verbatim extraction，更贴近预训练数据泄露的实际风险；同时检验量化对能力和记忆的相对影响。
summary.technical_approach: 使用 Pythia 系列模型和公开的已知记忆序列集合，在多个模型尺寸、五种精度设置和两种量化算法下，直接测量模型能否逐字抽取训练样本，并同步记录困惑度作为通用能力代理指标。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Pythia 的三个模型尺寸，精度从 full precision 到 4-bit，并在两个评测语料上复核。核心发现是：量化会选择性削弱逐字记忆，且记忆下降速度快于 perplexity 恶化；但这种下降不足以把量化视为可靠隐私防御。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LLM quantization reduces the risk of verbatim training-data extraction, rather than merely lowering membership-inference signals.
summary_en.importance: This is a privacy and memorization analysis contribution. It shifts the measurement target from membership inference to direct extraction, which is closer to the leakage risk that matters for pretraining data governance.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study uses Pythia models and a public set of sequences known to be memorized by those models, then measures verbatim extraction across five precision levels, three model sizes, two quantization methods, and two evaluation corpora while tracking perplexity.
summary_en.experiments: Across the tested Pythia sizes and quantization settings from full precision to 4-bit, memorization drops faster than general capability as measured by perplexity. The effect is robust across two quantizers and corpora, but not strong enough to make quantization a dependable privacy defense.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验表和量化曲线即可；它提醒预训练侧别用 membership inference 代替抽取风险评估。
recommendation.en: Skim the tables and quantization curves; the useful point is that membership inference is a weak proxy for extraction risk.

paper.title: SenWorld: A Digital-Twin Simulation for Generating Context-Rich Evaluation Data
paper.abstract: Smartphone personal assistants reason over longitudinal personal data, yet evaluating them requires context-rich evaluation data whose correct answers are known, and real device traces are too privacy-sensitive to share. To address this challenge, we present SenWorld, a physically grounded, deterministic, event-sourced digital-twin simulation that generates such data with ground truth fixed by construction. In SenWorld, personas live through a full day in a world built from real map, weather, ho

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是个人设备助手评测里的一个基础难题：怎样构造既有真实纵向上下文、又能给出可验证标准答案、同时还能共享复现的数据。真实手机轨迹最接近目标场景，但隐私上几乎不可共享；手工写 case 安全但状态稀薄，覆盖不了跨应用、跨时间、多跳检索；LLM 生成 query 或答案虽然快，但如果背后没有完整设备状态，正确性就只能依赖人工或 LLM judge，稳定性和可审计性都不够。SenWorld 的切入点不是继续改 judge，而是把“评测”重写成“可控世界状态生成”问题：只要模拟世界完整拥有设备状态，并且状态演化受物理与外部环境约束，那么很多问题的正确答案就不是事后标注出来的，而是由某一时刻快照中的唯一记录直接决定。
summary.importance: 对大模型基座研究的直接意义不在于训练方法，而在于评测数据生产范式。它给 personal agent / on-device assistant 这类系统提供了一种不依赖 LLM judge 的评测资产构造方式，尤其适合需要长期记忆、跨源检索、时空上下文绑定的任务。对预训练研究员而言，价值主要有三点。第一，它把“ground truth by construction”做到了设备级状态，而不是抽象任务后端，这对未来构造更高可信度的 agent eval 很重要。第二，它展示了 snapshot + pointer label 的标注形式，标签不是自然语言答案，而是指向底层记录的可验证引用，这比开放式文本评分更稳。第三，它说明了高质量评测集未必来自人工标注或模型蒸馏，也可以来自可复现模拟器。量级上，这更像评测基础设施而不是模型方法突破；对通用 LLM 预训练本身启发有限，但对 agent memory、tool use、personal context reasoning 的离线评测设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是一个 physically grounded、deterministic、event-sourced 的 digital twin。论文把 persona、手机、外部服务和物理环境放进同一个随时间推进的世界里统一演化。这里有几个关键设计。第一，物理与外部约束是真实注入的，不是纯文本虚构。世界构建会接入真实地图、天气、节假日、网络等外部数据，让位置、出行、通信、活动安排这些状态变化受现实条件约束。第二，系统是 deterministic 的，同样的初始条件和事件流会得到同样的世界轨迹，这保证了评测可复现。第三，采用 event sourcing 而不是只保留最终数据库状态。也就是每个状态变化都由事件驱动并被记录，系统可以在每个模拟帧导出 full-system snapshot。这样做的好处是，评测样本可以绑定到任意时刻的完整设备状态，而不是只看最终结果。第四，标签机制不是后验生成答案，而是把 query 的正确答案编码成 snapshot 中某个 source table 和 unique record id 的指针。比如“给住在这里的朋友打电话”，正确性最终落在联系人表中某条记录是否与当前位置关联，而不是落在某段自由文本是否看起来合理。第五，论文还设计了 snapshot-centered projection：同一个世界快照可以被确定性地投影成多种下游测试工件，比如用户可见上下文、结构化状态、评测 query 与目标记录等。这使模拟器既是数据生成器，也是评测样本工厂。与已有 state-grounded eval 相比，SenWorld 的区别在于它模拟的是更接近真实 smartphone ecosystem 的完整状态空间，而且评分绕开了 LLM judge。
summary.experiments: 实验主要围绕三件事展开。第一，分布层面的真实性。作者用北京场景下的 16 个 persona 运行整日模拟，并把生成数据与一个保留的真实用户基准在 6 个共享类别上做分布比较。摘要和正文给出的结论是生成分布与真实基准较接近，说明模拟器没有只生成模板化、过于规则的状态组合。第二，行为涌现。论文强调没有为每个 persona 手写 interaction script，而是让行为在环境、日程、设备状态和 persona 设定共同作用下自然出现，进而产生联系人、位置、通信、应用状态之间的长程关联。这一点很关键，因为如果交互脚本是手工编排的，评测集很容易退化成作者预设的有限模式。第三，实用性验证。作者把生成的 evaluation cases 用于诊断一个生产级 smartphone assistant，发现这些 case 能暴露真实缺陷，并帮助定位问题来源。就全文可见内容看，这篇论文更强调评测资产的构造逻辑和案例诊断价值，而不是追求大规模 benchmark 数字。参数量、训练 token、模型提升幅度这类信息并不是重点，因为它不是模型训练论文。若要抓实验重点，建议关注分布对齐图、case 构造示例，以及生产系统缺陷分析部分，而不是期待标准 leaderboard 式结果。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先看 Introduction 和 Method，把问题设定吃透，再看实验图表。优先关注三处。第一，SenWorld 的世界状态定义与事件驱动更新机制，这决定了为什么它能给出 by-construction 的标签。第二，snapshot-centered projection 的具体形式，理解“一个快照如何变成多个评测工件”，这是方法最有可迁移性的部分。第三，生产助手缺陷诊断案例，那里最能看出这种评测数据相比人工 case 或 LLM judge 的实际差异。预计 20 到 30 分钟可以抓住主线；如果只关心是否值得纳入 agent eval 工具箱，看引言、方法总览图和实验最后一节就够了。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a hard evaluation bottleneck for personal device assistants: how to build context-rich, longitudinal evaluation data with reliable ground truth, without relying on private real-device traces. Real smartphone logs are the natural source, but they are not shareable. Manual case writing is safe but too shallow. LLM-generated cases scale, yet correctness becomes dependent on post-hoc checking or LLM judges. SenWorld reframes the problem: instead of improving answer judging, it constructs a simulated world whose device state is fully owned, reproducible, and physically constrained, so the correct answer is determined directly by the world state at a given time.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation-data production paradigm rather than a model-training advance. For LLM base-model researchers, the relevance is indirect but real: it offers a way to build agent evaluation assets where labels are fixed by construction, especially for tasks involving memory, multi-source retrieval, and temporal context. Two ideas stand out. First, it moves from abstract backend state to a smartphone-like ecosystem, which is closer to the actual failure modes of personal assistants. Second, it replaces free-form answer judging with pointer-based labels into structured records. That makes evaluation more auditable and less dependent on noisy LLM judges. The impact is stronger for agent eval and personal-context reasoning than for core pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: SenWorld is a physically grounded, deterministic, event-sourced digital twin. Personas, smartphones, external services, and physical context evolve together in one simulated world. Several design choices matter. Real-world constraints are injected through maps, weather, holidays, and network data, so movement, communication, and device state changes are not purely fictional. The system is deterministic, which supports reproducibility. It is also event-sourced, meaning state transitions are recorded as events and full-system snapshots can be exported at each simulated frame. This allows evaluation cases to be tied to exact moments in a longitudinal trajectory. Ground truth is represented as a pointer into the snapshot, such as a source table plus a unique record ID, rather than a natural-language answer. The paper also introduces a snapshot-centered projection mechanism: one world snapshot can be deterministically transformed into multiple downstream testing artifacts. Compared with prior state-grounded evaluation setups, the key difference is that SenWorld targets a richer smartphone ecosystem and avoids LLM-based judging in the final scoring loop.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical section focuses on three questions. First, distributional fidelity: the authors simulate full-day trajectories for 16 personas in Beijing and compare generated data against a held-out real-user benchmark over six shared categories. The reported conclusion is that the synthetic data tracks the real benchmark reasonably well at the distribution level. Second, emergent behavior: instead of hand-authoring interaction scripts for each persona, the framework lets behavior arise from persona settings, schedules, environment, and device dynamics, producing nontrivial links across contacts, locations, communication logs, and app state. Third, practical utility: the generated evaluation cases are used to diagnose defects in a production smartphone assistant, and the paper shows that these cases can surface concrete failures and help localize them. This is not a model-scaling paper, so readers should not expect parameter-count or training-token tables. The experimental value lies in the realism checks, case studies, and defect analysis.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the introduction and method first. The key is to understand why the authors treat evaluation as a state-generation problem. Then focus on three parts: the world-state and event model, the snapshot-centered projection mechanism, and the production-assistant defect case studies. Those sections make clear what is genuinely new and what is mostly engineering integration. A quick but useful read should take about 20 to 30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读数据生成和 label pointer 设计；它给个人助理 eval 一个比 LLM judge 更干净的替代方案。
recommendation.en: Read the data-generation and label-pointer design; it offers a cleaner personal-assistant eval path than LLM judging.

paper.title: JUMP: Single-Pass Membership Inference on Fine-Tuned Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Membership inference attacks (MIAs) test whether a candidate example appeared in a model's training data. We study MIAs for fine-tuned discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs), where membership means inclusion in the target model's fine-tuning set. Unlike autoregressive language models, dLLMs allow an attacker to choose arbitrary mask sets and obtain token distributions for all masked positions in parallel. The prior dLLM attack, SAMA, follows a natural loss-mimicking strategy by averaging rec

summary.core_problem: 针对微调后的离散扩散语言模型（dLLM）做成员推断攻击（MIA），判断样本是否出现在微调集中。
summary.importance: 首次系统性利用 dLLM 相对 AR 的两个独特接口——any-order 可解码和并行解码——来做单次查询 MIA，比之前 SAMA 的多次随机掩码查询更高效；对扩散 LM 训练数据隐私和数据检测有直接意义。
summary.technical_approach: JUMP (Joint Uncertainty-Guided Mask Probing)：用 any-order 可解码性选择参考模型置信度低的位置，再用并行可解码性对这些位置做一次联合掩码查询打分；替代 SAMA 在大量随机掩码上平均重建信号的做法，把查询次数从多次降到单 pass。
summary.experiments: 在微调 dLLM 上对比 SAMA 等基线，JUMP 单次查询即达到或超过多次查询的攻击准确率（abstract 截断，具体数据集和数值未给出）。

summary_en.core_problem: Membership inference attacks against fine-tuned discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs), determining whether a candidate example appeared in the fine-tuning set.
summary_en.importance: First to systematically exploit two dLLM-specific interfaces—any-order decodability and parallel decodability—for single-query MIA, far more query-efficient than the prior SAMA attack that averages over many random masks; directly relevant to diffusion LM training-data privacy and data detection.
summary_en.technical_approach: JUMP (Joint Uncertainty-Guided Mask Probing) uses any-order decodability to select positions with low reference-model confidence, then uses parallel decodability to score all selected positions with one joint masked query per model, replacing SAMA's many random-mask queries with a single pass.
summary_en.experiments: Compared against SAMA and other baselines on fine-tuned dLLMs; JUMP matches or exceeds multi-query attack accuracy with a single query (abstract truncated, exact datasets and numbers not provided).

recommendation.zh: 扩散 LM 的 MIA 比 AR 强不是因为模型更差，而是 any-order 接口本身泄露更多信息，做 dLLM 预训练/微调数据发布前必看。
recommendation.en: dLLMs are more vulnerable to MIA not because they are worse models but because the any-order interface leaks more; required reading before releasing diffusion LM pretrain/finetune data.

paper.title: Efficient and Privacy Aware Edge Cloud Collaborative Inference for Large Language Models
paper.abstract: On-device LLM inference faces a trilemma of response latency, limited hardware resources and user privacy. Full cloud inference delivers strong computing power but exposes user prompts and dialogue data, while standalone on-device inference is unfeasible for most consumer and embedded edge devices. This paper presents a privacy-centric edge-cloud collaborative LLM inference framework built on endpoint-authenticated KV cache. Local endpoints handle input preprocessing, embedding computation, adap

summary.core_problem: 解决端侧 LLM 推理在延迟、算力受限与隐私保护之间的三难问题，尝试在边缘与云之间拆分推理路径。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏系统工程：把 KV cache、speculative decoding、量化传输和加密结合到 edge-cloud 协同推理中。对预训练本身帮助有限，但对推理系统、隐私约束部署和模型切分有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方案在本地端执行输入预处理、embedding、特征优化、KV cache 认证、speculative decoding 和低维 head 计算；云端负责认证后的 decoder 推理、KV cache 管理、token 验证和高维词表投影。传输数据与截断 logits 做量化并用 AES-GCM 加密，核心是 endpoint-authenticated KV cache 的协同推理框架。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出具体模型规模、硬件配置、吞吐/时延数字，也未说明与纯云端、纯端侧或已有 split inference baseline 的系统性比较。现阶段更像设计提案，证据强度有限。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles the latency-resource-privacy trade-off in on-device LLM inference by splitting inference between edge devices and the cloud.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is primarily systems-oriented: it combines KV-cache handling, speculative decoding, quantized transmission, and encryption in an edge-cloud collaborative setup. It is only indirectly relevant to pretraining researchers, but may inform deployment under privacy constraints.
summary_en.technical_approach: The endpoint handles preprocessing, embeddings, adaptive feature optimization, KV-cache authentication, speculative decoding, and a low-dimensional head, while the cloud performs authenticated decoder inference, cache management, token verification, and full-vocabulary projection. Data and truncated logits are quantized and encrypted with AES-GCM, centered around an endpoint-authenticated KV-cache design.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, hardware details, latency/throughput numbers, or clean comparisons against cloud-only, device-only, or prior split-inference baselines. At this stage, it reads more like a system design than a well-validated empirical study.

recommendation.zh: 只在你关心隐私约束下的 split inference 时值得扫一眼；摘要里系统点子不少，但没有干净数字前先别改 prior。
recommendation.en: Only skim if privacy-constrained split inference matters to you; there are some system ideas here, but without clean numbers it should not update your priors.

paper.title: When T2I Synthetic Data Backfires: Amplified Privacy Risks in Real-Synthetic Mix Training
paper.abstract: To overcome data scarcity and privacy constraints in data collection, it has become standard practice across academia and industry to augment real training data with text-to-image (T2I)-generated synthetic data, a paradigm we term Real-Synthetic Mix-Training (RSMT). While substituting synthetic data for sensitive real samples is widely regarded as a means to mitigate privacy exposure of the substituted data, the risk to the remaining real samples that actively participate in training has remaine

summary.core_problem: T2I模型训练中普遍认为合成数据替代部分真实数据可降低隐私风险，但未被替换的剩余真实样本的隐私泄露风险未被系统研究。
summary.importance: 首次揭示真实-合成数据混合训练（RSMT）会放大剩余真实样本的隐私泄露，提出记忆放大理论框架和风险评估方法，挑战了“合成数据必然降低隐私风险”的直觉。
summary.technical_approach: 建立RSMT记忆放大理论框架，证明合成数据会将真实样本挤压到混合特征空间边缘，迫使模型更激进地记忆这些样本；基于该理论设计RSMixLeak成员推断攻击流程，量化隐私放大程度。
summary.experiments: 在T2I生成模型训练场景下验证了理论效应，显示混合合成数据后剩余真实样本的成员推断攻击成功率显著上升；摘要截断了具体模型、数据集和量化结果细节。

summary_en.core_problem: In text-to-image (T2I) model training, it is widely assumed that substituting part of real training data with synthetic samples reduces privacy risks, but privacy exposure of the remaining non-substituted real samples has not been systematically examined.
summary_en.importance: This work is the first to demonstrate that real-synthetic mix training (RSMT) amplifies privacy leakage of remaining real samples, proposes a theoretical memorization amplification framework to explain the effect, and introduces a corresponding risk assessment method, challenging the intuition that synthetic data universally reduces privacy risk.
summary_en.technical_approach: Develops the RSMT Memorization Amplification framework, proving synthetic data displaces real samples to peripheral regions of the mixed feature space, forcing models to memorize these outlying real samples more aggressively; designs RSMixLeak, a membership inference attack pipeline to systematically quantify amplified privacy risk.
summary_en.experiments: Validated in T2I generative model training setups, showing significantly higher membership inference success rates on remaining real samples after mixing in synthetic data; specific model, dataset, and quantitative details are truncated in the available abstract.

recommendation.zh: T2I场景下发现合成数据混合训练会放大真实样本记忆与隐私泄露，机制可能外溢到LM合成数据预训练，但无LM实验，知道结论即可，无需深读。
recommendation.en: Finds amplified real sample memorization when mixing T2I synthetic data, a mechanism potentially relevant to LLM synthetic data pretraining, but no LM experiments are included—just note the finding, no deep read needed.

paper.title: Security and Privacy in Agentic AI: Grand Challenges and Future Directions
paper.abstract: We present key challenges and future research directions in the security and privacy of agentic AI, based on a horizon-scanning exercise that brought together thirty leading international experts from academia, industry, and government to engage in focused discussions and collaborative exercises on the emerging risks associated with the growing agency of AI.

summary.core_problem: 梳理 Agentic AI 在安全与隐私上的关键挑战，并提出未来研究方向。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是专家研讨式的议题梳理，不是新模型、新 benchmark 或新训练方法。它的价值在于给工具使用、自主行动、数据访问和人类监督不足带来的风险做问题分解。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是 horizon-scanning exercise：组织来自学术界、产业界和政府的专家进行聚焦讨论与协作练习，总结随着 AI agency 增强而出现的安全隐私风险。
summary.experiments: 没有实验结果、模型训练或系统评测。摘要只说明参与者包括三十位国际专家，产出是挑战列表和未来方向。

summary_en.core_problem: The article maps major security and privacy challenges for agentic AI and outlines future research directions.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an expert-driven agenda rather than a model, benchmark, or training method. It is useful for structuring risks around tool use, autonomy, data access, and limited human oversight.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work is based on a horizon-scanning exercise with focused discussions and collaborative activities among experts from academia, industry, and government.
summary_en.experiments: There are no model experiments, training runs, or quantitative evaluations. The abstract reports participation from thirty international experts and a synthesis of challenges and directions.

recommendation.zh: 适合扫目录补安全风险 taxonomy，不需要细读；对 pretrain 的直接反馈信号很弱。
recommendation.en: Useful as a taxonomy of agent-security risks, not worth a full read; the feedback signal for pretraining is weak.

paper.title: Janus: a Playground for User-Involved Agentic Permission Management
paper.abstract: AI agents that autonomously execute tool calls on a user's behalf raise pressing questions about permission management: what role could users play, and what role should they play? Despite many proposed approaches, the user's role in agentic permission management remains under explored. We introduce Janus, a playground system for implementing and evaluating user-involved agentic permission management designs. Janus consists of two components: Janus-Core, a modular agentic system supporting a dive

summary.core_problem: 研究自主工具调用 Agent 中，用户应该如何参与权限管理，以及不同用户参与设计如何影响隐私、安全和认知负担。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 安全与交互系统。它不是预训练方法论文，但把权限管理拆成可实现、可评估的设计轴，对未来通用 Agent 的安全边界和工具调用协议有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Janus playground，包括 Janus-Core 和 Janus-Harness。Janus-Core 是模块化 Agent 系统，可实现不同权限管理策略；Janus-Harness 用自动化方式评估这些策略。论文基于一个用户参与权限管理的概念模型，实现了 6 个 permission assistants，并用合成用户响应器测试不同交互策略。
summary.experiments: 在 3 类场景和 3 个 synthetic responders 上评估 6 种权限助手。摘要给出的主要结果是：用户输入能显著增强隐私与安全；AI 辅助用户决策可降低认知负担。未从摘要中看到大模型规模、真实用户实验规模或开放 benchmark 数字。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括华盛顿大学安全与隐私方向的 Tadayoshi Kohno 和 Franziska Roesner，他们长期研究系统安全、隐私和人机交互安全。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how users should participate in permission management for autonomous tool-using agents, and how design choices affect privacy, security, and user burden.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent safety and interaction-systems contribution rather than a pretraining paper. Its value is in decomposing agentic permission management into implementable and evaluable design axes, which is relevant to future tool-use protocols.
summary_en.technical_approach: Janus is introduced as a playground with two parts: Janus-Core, a modular agentic system supporting multiple permission-management designs, and Janus-Harness, an automated evaluation framework. The authors instantiate six permission assistants over a conceptual design space for user involvement.
summary_en.experiments: The six assistants are evaluated across three scenarios and three synthetic responders. The reported findings are that user input materially improves privacy and security, while AI augmentation can reduce cognitive load. The abstract does not specify model scale, real-user study size, or a standardized benchmark release.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes University of Washington security and privacy researchers Tadayoshi Kohno and Franziska Roesner, known for work on computer security, privacy, and human-centered security.

recommendation.zh: 只看概念模型和 6 个助手的对比；对预训练没直接作用，但能校准 tool-use Agent 的权限边界。
recommendation.en: Read only the design axes and six-assistant comparison; it does not affect pretraining directly, but it sharpens priors on permission boundaries for tool-using agents.

paper.title: MemLeak: Diagnosing Information Leaks in Multimodal Agent Memory
paper.abstract: When a multimodal AI agent is asked to forget a fact, current memory systems usually delete the text entry and report success. We find that the fact can remain recoverable from retained user images, including images tagged to entirely different facts, because VLMs use implicit visual cues at inference time. We introduce the Information Provenance Graph (IPG), a taxonomy that classifies memory representations by deletion affordance. The IPG reveals that deletion fails through multiple channels. O

summary.core_problem: 多模态 agent 记忆系统在执行“事实级遗忘/删除”时存在跨表征信息残留：删除显式文本条目和直接关联的图像后，被要求遗忘的用户事实仍可通过其他留存图像中的隐式视觉线索，以及相关文本痕迹，被 VLM 推理恢复。
summary.importance: 对长期记忆系统和多模态 agent 设计有直接警示意义，尤其说明机器遗忘不能只做记录级删除，也不能只做文本审计。对预训练研究的启发在于：VLM 把视觉特征与语义知识强绑定后，“删除一个事实”变成跨模态、跨存储层的问题；未来在统一多模态建模与个人化记忆机制里，信息可追溯性和可控遗忘会成为基础能力，而不只是合规补丁。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Information Provenance Graph（IPG），把一个事实在 agent 记忆系统中的多种表征拆成节点，用有向边表示信息派生关系，并给每个节点标注 deletion affordance：可直接寻址删除（addr）、依赖来源链才能删除（link）、当前存储机制难以触及（unreach）。基于这个分解构造 MemLeak benchmark，在删除级联上逐层测量恢复率：先看显式删除后的直连 probe，再测保留相关文本时的恢复，再测保留其他关联图像时的恢复，并区分纯文本可恢复与仅视觉可恢复的泄露通道。
summary.experiments: 在 300 条评估样本上，直接探测“已支持删除”的系统，恢复率远低于 1%；但保留相关文本时，被删事实恢复率达到 18.3%；保留用户其余图像时，恢复率为 12.0%；盲基线（无图像）为 0.0%，负对照（其他用户图像）FPR 为 0.3%。其中 47% 的图像泄露无法仅靠留存文本恢复，说明视觉通道是文本审计覆盖不到的单独泄露路径。论文还测试了生产级记忆系统 Mem0，并在多种 VLM 和真实照片上验证现象稳定存在；加入语义级审计后，图像残留可降到约 2.0%，但不能完全消除。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可。重点看第 2 节 IPG 的分类法，以及实验部分对“文本通道/图像通道/组合通道”恢复率的拆解；Figure 1 给出的潜水偏好例子最直观，能快速理解为什么隐式视觉线索会让事实级删除失效。对做 agent memory、多模态对齐和个人化系统的人更值得看；若主要关心纯文本预训练本体，可只抓核心结论：跨模态表示会让删除和遗忘问题从“删记录”变成“删推断路径”。预计阅读 20–30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Multimodal agent memory systems fail at fact-level forgetting: after a user requests deletion of a fact, standard systems remove the explicit text entry and directly linked images, but the fact can still be reconstructed from retained correlated text and implicit visual cues in other retained images using VLM inference.
summary_en.importance: This is a useful systems diagnosis for long-term memory and multimodal agents. The main lesson for foundation-model research is that forgetting is not equivalent to record deletion once representations become cross-modal. After pretraining, VLMs bind visual cues to semantic knowledge tightly enough that residual user data can support reconstruction of deleted facts even when no explicit trace remains. This makes provenance tracking and controllable forgetting a core design issue for unified multimodal and personalized memory systems rather than a narrow compliance feature.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces the Information Provenance Graph (IPG), a taxonomy that represents a single fact as a DAG over memory representations, with edges marking derivation paths and nodes labeled by deletion affordance: directly addressable (addr), deletable only if provenance links are maintained (link), or unreachable by current storage-level deletion mechanisms (unreach). Based on this decomposition, MemLeak evaluates forgetting as a deletion cascade: first probing explicitly deleted entries, then measuring recovery from retained correlated text, then from retained unrelated-but-correlated images, and finally isolating leaks recoverable only through vision.
summary_en.experiments: Across 300 evaluation examples, direct probing of deletion-capable systems yields recovery well below 1%, but retained correlated text enables 18.3% recovery and retained images enable 12.0% recovery, compared with a 0.0% blind baseline and 0.3% false-positive rate for other-user image controls. 47% of image-based leaks are not recoverable from retained text alone, showing a visually mediated leakage channel invisible to text-only auditing. The phenomenon is validated across multiple VLMs, real photographs, and a production memory system (Mem0); content-aware semantic auditing reduces the image residual to around 2.0% but does not eliminate it.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. The most useful parts are Section 2 on the IPG taxonomy and the experimental decomposition into text, image, and combined leakage channels. Figure 1 is the fastest way to grasp the core phenomenon: seemingly unrelated retained images contain enough visual cues for a VLM to reconstruct a deleted user preference. The paper is more relevant to agent memory and multimodal systems than to core pretraining mechanics; for pretraining-focused readers, the key takeaway is that cross-modal representations turn forgetting into an inference-path problem. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看 benchmark 设计和泄漏通道表；它会改变对“删除文本记忆就足够”的默认假设。
recommendation.en: Read the benchmark design and leakage-channel table; it weakens the default assumption that deleting text memory is enough.

paper.title: Natural Identifiers for Privacy and Data Audits in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Assessing the privacy of large language models (LLMs) presents significant challenges. In particular, most existing methods for auditing differential privacy require the insertion of specially crafted canary data during training, making them impractical for auditing already-trained models without costly retraining. Additionally, dataset inference, which audits whether a suspect dataset was used to train a model, is infeasible without access to a private non-member held-out dataset. Yet, such hel

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 LLM 隐私与数据审计中的两个实际障碍：差分隐私审计通常需要训练前插入 canary，无法对已训练模型做低成本 post-hoc 审计；dataset inference 又需要与可疑数据同分布的非成员 held-out 集，现实中很难获得。
summary.importance: 对预训练数据研究的价值在于，它提供了一种更可操作的训练数据成员审计接口。论文提出 natural identifiers，利用训练语料中自然出现的结构化随机字符串，例如哈希、短链接、加密货币地址。这类字符串有明确生成规则，因此可以生成同分布的非成员样本。这个思路把“必须预先埋 canary”变成“利用语料中天然存在的随机标识符”，使已发布模型的数据使用审计和隐私审计更可行。它也提醒预训练数据治理：代码库、论坛和网页中的随机标识符不是普通噪声，可能成为可检测的训练数据指纹。
summary.technical_approach: 论文的核心技术是 Natural Identifiers，简称 NIDs。NIDs 是由已知机制生成、在自然语料中真实存在的随机字符串。由于格式分布可复现，审计者可以针对某种 NID 类型生成大量同分布的 non-member 样本。对于 DP 审计，论文改造 Steinke et al. 的 one-run auditing 框架，用训练集中自然出现的 NID 作为事后 canary，再用生成的同分布 NID 构造审计集，从而不需要重新训练模型。对于 dataset inference，流程是先在可疑数据集里识别 NID 类型，再生成同类型 held-out 集，然后用已有 DI 方法比较模型在 suspect NIDs 和 generated non-member NIDs 上的行为差异。与人工注入 canary 的方法相比，这个方案不要求修改预训练数据，也不要求访问私有同分布验证集。
